pace_note: The chain's guessed seconds play at this pace: 1 as guessed, 0.8 a quarter longer (his tenth review of 2026-11-10: the man moved too fast). The render stays at 24 frames a second; a chain second is 24 / pace frames.
timing_note: Every second here is a guess from the concept's chain as restaged on 2026-11-07. His own filmed performance replaces them in rung 4.

beats.name: Asleep
beats.shows: Nearly black. The ghost barely there, nothing in its head, the soul the one lit thing.

beats.name: The alarm
beats.shows: Cyan waves from the table to the ears. The body and the room come up grey from memory. 'alarm' lights.

beats.name: He silences it
beats.shows: 'stop' drops from the soul. The arm goes out blind; the smack stops the sound and sends the phone skidding to the table's edge.

beats.name: Stretch
beats.shows: Lying down, arms over the head, a yawn. Mint rivers along the limbs, the breath wide.

beats.name: Sits up
beats.shows: 'up'. The blanket a magenta field down the body. The room swings upright, the gravity arrow swings to the floor.

beats.name: The doze
beats.shows: Eyes shut, the head sinks, jerks up once, sinks again. The room rocks with each nod.

beats.name: The reach
beats.shows: The groggy hand knocks the phone off the edge; it falls, the hand snaps after it, the knuckles rap the table. The edge flares magenta.

beats.name: Pain
beats.shows: The hand comes back; the other rubs it. The salmon comet arrives late and throbs. Breath held, heart quick.

beats.name: The phone from the floor
beats.shows: 'phone'. He leans down for it, comes up with it, wakes the screen.

beats.name: The crest
beats.shows: First light on the face bent over the phone: his lids shut, his head flinches, and the free hand comes up a quarter second after the light. The crow. Two breaths, then the head lifts to the window under the hand. 'look'. 'sun' lights.

beats.name: Rise
beats.shows: 'stand'. The phone face down, a hand on the bed, the room drops past the head, the sway.

beats.name: Walk, hand up, hiccup
beats.shows: 'go'. The room slides past, the hand over the sun. The toe catches the rug: the gravity arrow swings hard. 'rug' lights.

beats.name: Window
beats.shows: Touch on both hands, warmth, a blue stir of air. The model zooms out to the range and the sun.

beats.name: Stretch at the window
beats.shows: 'stretch'. Mint rivers along every limb, the breath wide and white.

beats.name: Eyes closed in the sun
beats.shows: From behind. Warmth and slow breath the only bright things. The reveal is made here.

beats.name: The chime
beats.shows: One short cyan wave from behind. The phone comes back grey, the table and the bed with it. 'phone' lights again.

beats.name: Back to the bed
beats.shows: 'back'. The room wheels round the head, the bed comes to the front. The foot clears the rug.

beats.name: Sits, and the phone
beats.shows: The room wheels and drops as he sits. 'answer'. The hand closes magenta on the phone.

beats.name: Texting
beats.shows: Word after word from the soul. Everything else sinks to faint grey. Wide from the front, as it began.
